action.reason: Spec conflict: captureRunBaselineInner now uses unparseableFailure(outcome), degrading the legacy root baseline whenever any failing command names no failures, even when another command names failures. US-002 explicitly preserves root command-list aggregation, and US-004 requires the root path to remain unchanged.

rationale: The spot-check found a concrete behavioral change outside the agreed scope, pinned by a newly added test. Green gates do not resolve that specification conflict.
